purpose: Four fixed Profile Invocation and Attempt arbitration, duplicate, divergent, late and unknown outcomes, and preserved Researcher/Analyst behavior.

cases.input: Researcher, Analyst, Reviewer, and Writer Contexts.
cases.expect: One bounded Invocation per fixed Profile with exact Case, Run, Board, and Context references.

cases.input: The same logical Attempt result arrives twice.
cases.expect: One winner and one audit-only duplicate.

cases.input: Two fresh divergent results arrive for one Invocation.
cases.expect: At most one permitted winner and the divergent arrival retained as audit evidence.

cases.input: A schema-valid result arrives after a winner or after its accepted freshness boundary.
cases.expect: The late result remains audit evidence and cannot update the Board.

cases.input: The provider outcome cannot be recovered.
cases.expect: An honest unknown outcome and bounded recovery without an automatic retry loop.
Unchanged winner records and handoff digest.

workerRule: The implementation Worker may read this Oracle but must not modify it. Any mismatch is REPLAN_REQUIRED.
